info.title: Metaframer headless API
info.description: ERPNext is the source of truth; no mock fallback. Static admin/storefront frontends run on GitHub Pages and call the API-only server. AUTH_MODE=bearer uses an encrypted opaque 8-hour admin session; cookie mode remains the local default. Anonymous public catalog routes expose only enabled sales Items in the configured leaf Item Group. Internal catalog routes still require a separate server secret. Non-allowlisted browser Origins are rejected.

servers.description: API-only production server; frontends are on https://metafrappe.github.io
Local development; cookie authentication by default

AdminSession.name: mf_admin_session
AdminSession.description: AUTH_MODE=cookie only (default). Encrypted HttpOnly SameSite=Lax cookie, Secure in production. A deployment accepts its configured mode, not both modes simultaneously.

CatalogKey.description: Server-to-server CATALOG_SHARED_SECRET; not the admin accessToken or Frappe API token. Never embed in Pages/browser code.

AdminBearer.description: AUTH_MODE=bearer only. Encrypted 8-hour accessToken from login. Send in Authorization only; query tokens and cookie fallback are not accepted. Every protected request revalidates the upstream Frappe user. Writes additionally require allowed Origin and X-CSRF-Token.

BearerLogin.description: AUTH_MODE=bearer login response; session endpoint does not rotate or return accessToken.

LoginResponse.description: Response depends on deployment AUTH_MODE; cookie mode also sets mf_admin_session.

catalogConfigured.description: Configuration presence only; does not prove upstream reachability or successful CRUD.

CorsOrigin.name: Origin
CorsOrigin.description: Exact configured Origin; no wildcard or suffix matching.

CorsHeaders.name: Access-Control-Request-Headers
CorsHeaders.description: Optional comma-separated subset of Content-Type, Authorization, X-CSRF-Token (case-insensitive).

x-cors.origins: Exact APP_ORIGIN plus comma-separated ALLOWED_ORIGINS; no wildcard, paths, null or subdomain matching. Pages Origin is https://metafrappe.github.io.
x-cors.credentials: Only cookie mode sets Access-Control-Allow-Credentials=true. Bearer/browser calls use credentials: omit.

x-api-only: API_ONLY=1 serves no static UI or SPA fallback; non-API paths return 404. GitHub Pages hosts both frontends.
